title: Coast Guard rescues 7 near NYC
description: A helicopter crew from Coast Guard Air Station Atlantic City, N.J., rescues seven people Thursday, Feb. 25, 2016, near New York. The helicopter crew hoisted the fishermen from the aground 76-foot fishing vessel Carolina Queen III and transferred them ashore. U.S. Coast Guard video
